# Overall Project Summary: Aug 27, 2026

On August 27, 2026, the ElizaOS team focused on hardening cloud infrastructure and expanding multi-agent capabilities, including the introduction of autonomous sales negotiation arenas. Significant progress was also made in UI/UX canonicalization and Android mobile stability, alongside a high volume of new pull requests aimed at testing and infrastructure refinement.

## ✅ Completed Work

**Cloud Infrastructure & Security**
*   Strengthened system reliability by implementing durable backup admission cursor schemas and hardening inference fast paths ([elizaos/eliza#29194](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29194), [elizaos/eliza#29385](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29385)).
*   Improved fleet health monitoring with new provisioning worker checks and database authority auditing ([elizaos/eliza#29417](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29417), [elizaos/eliza#29427](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29427)).
*   Enhanced security by enforcing strict identity verification for Personal Shared agents and user sessions ([elizaos/eliza#29345](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29345), [elizaos/eliza#29445](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29445)).

**UI/UX Design System**
*   Unified the design system by canonicalizing page geometries and standardizing route layouts for Notes and Automations ([elizaos/eliza#29303](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29303), [elizaos/eliza#29528](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29528), [elizaos/eliza#29556](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29556), [elizaos/eliza#29578](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29578), [elizaos/eliza#29586](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29586)).

**Multi-Agent & Performance Optimization**
*   Enabled complex agent interactions by introducing autonomous sales negotiation and multi-runtime arenas ([elizaos/eliza#29533](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29533), [elizaos/eliza#29557](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29557)).
*   Boosted core performance by eliminating redundant planner states for deterministic tool calls ([elizaos/eliza#29447](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29447)).

**Android Mobile Stability**
*   Stabilized the mobile experience through improved native bridge routing for voice, chat composer fixes, and AAB build path alignment ([elizaos/eliza#29393](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29393), [elizaos/eliza#29444](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29444), [elizaos/eliza#29552](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29552)).
